description:
List offers

Every offer of the account: model, key, status, price, checks, health (the last liveness ping and identity probe), and the model's market as a seller sees it (anonymised levels, the best discount, the gap to it, outbid, whether your ask rests in the book and its rank). Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.
